conversation.text: You said your training left you poorly prepared. What is happening?

My training was just one slide deck and my buddy's been too busy with month-end, so I had to learn invoice posting from YouTube videos. A two-hour hands-on SAP session with real cases would really help me avoid posting invoices to the wrong cost centre like I had to reverse last week.

Here is what I will tell HR: The onboarding training was limited to a single slide deck, requiring independent learning for invoice posting tasks. [ONBOARDING_TRAINING] "My training was just one slide deck and my buddy's been too busy with month-end, so I had to learn invoice posting from YouTube videos."
